Touch stays as today: one finger rotates, two move and zoom. Middle-click's autoscroll (Windows) and paste (Linux) are blocked over the model. The model gets a visible focus ring when tabbed to.

4. Axis triad

Every picture that shows a model has an axis triad in the model's bottom-left corner: X, Y and Z arrows, each labelled, that turn with the part as you rotate it. The axes are the part's own axes, the ones the setups name ("from −X").

Arrow colours follow the usual X red, Y green, Z blue, and the corner triad's arrows carry their letters, so colour isn't the only cue there (X red is close to the Fix red; the letter tells them apart). The build checks the letters' contrast (Y and Z read pale here).

Settled rules this changes

Each becomes a Proposed entry in DECISIONS with the final plan; none changes until you approve it.

  • UI_STYLE "Selected finding" (docs/UI_STYLE.md:69): "A row selects all its findings' faces" becomes "a row lights the finding it shows". While something is picked, other findings and the Show OK tints turn plain grey (still faded to 0.35), not their colours (your round 1 answer).
  • D-042: "Change file" leaves the Part overview; Open… in the top bar replaces it, and the start form's two pickers become one.
  • D-023 (selectable setups): in the Machine view a setup chip also turns the part so the spindle is on top, and a tool row lights the faces that tool cuts in that setup.
  • D-017 pins: unchanged when the part is still; hidden while it moves (new).
  • Axis triad: new; no settled rule touched.
  • Mouse: today middle-drag zooms (three.js default); it becomes move, as in Inventor.

Tap sizes: the tool rows on Machining are about 22 px tall today, under the 32 px minimum (UI_STYLE); as buttons they grow to at least 32 px. The ‹ › buttons and "Show on model ›" are checked against 32 px in the build too.

Checks you can try on the work copy

  • Pick Deep hole ×2 on report_sample: one hole lit, the rest grey; › lights the other.
  • Spin the part with the wheel and by dragging: no pins while it moves, pins back within a quarter second of stopping. I will also time a big part on a production build before and after and give you the numbers.
  • Middle-drag moves, Shift + middle-drag rotates, the wheel zooms to the mouse, in Chrome or Edge at work; no autoscroll circle.
  • Tab to the model: arrows rotate, + − zoom, H goes home.
  • Open… with a STEP and its .ipt picked together; Examples ▾ loads each of the four.
  • Machining, Machine: each setup chip puts the spindle on top; tapping a tool lights its faces and shows it in the spindle.
  • Rotate the part: the corner triad turns with it.
